name: Helios VR - Early Access
summary:
In Helios VR, you play as an H9 Unit, floating through the Helios space station. The station is split into three sectors, each with its own activities and areas to explore.

The Capture the Flag Sector is built for teamwork and competition. Test your skills in the arena, try the mini arena, practice at the shooting range, or explore the core room, workshop, and medbay.

The PvP Sector is for friendly battles. Step into the punching room or fight in the PvP arena.

The Hangout Sector is perfect for relaxing.
